questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.solution:
We know that, (1,0), (0,1), (0,0) lies on X-axis, Y-axis and on the origin respectively.

So, (2k,3k) will lie on circle whose diameter is AB.

Equation of the circle will be given by,

⇒(x-1)(x)+(y-1)(y)=0

⇒x2+y2-x-y=0   ...i

Using (2k, 3k) in equation i,

⇒(2k)2+(3k)2-2k-3k=0

⇒13k2-5k=0

⇒k=0, k=513

Hence, k=513.

Given,

C1 : x2+ y2–4x– 2y+5 – α= 0

And C2 : 5x2+5y2–10fx–10gy+36=0

⇒C2 : x2+y2–2fx–2gy +365=0

So, Centre O2 = f, g and radius r=f2+g2-365

Also given O2 is reflection of O1 in 2x–y+1=0, so image formula we get,

⇒f-22=g-1-1=-2·2×2-1+122+12

⇒f=-65 and g=135

So, radius r=-652+1352-365=255=1

⇒r=1 and α =1 as they both are same radius circle,

Hence, r+α=2.
